Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month, which totals 18.0 days across a full plan year.

Next steps:
- Review your MosaicOne balance
- Contact People Operations with questions

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, so that a team's onsite days overlap and the office time is actually collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period; employees may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, a promotion, or a change from part-time to full-time status. It is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

Next steps:
- Enroll in benefits during week one
- Review MosaicOne Benefits elections within 30 days of eligibility

Do not reply to the message and do not act on the request. Report it to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example and delete it.

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for bulk personal-data extracts over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

The security team answers every phishing report, including the ones that turn out to be legitimate mail, and publishes a short monthly summary of what was seen.

Next steps:
- Forward to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not reply or act

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories, including items such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, and small filing cabinet.

Next steps:
- Review eligible items in MosaicOne Expenses
- Submit claims by month-end for next payroll

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent, regardless of whether the employee gave birth, adopted, became a parent through surrogacy, or foster placement leading to adoption.

Parental leave eligibility begins after 6 months of continuous service. An employee who becomes a parent before reaching six months receives the statutory entitlement their jurisdiction provides, and the company benefit begins the day the service requirement is met.

An employee who gives birth also receives any period of medical disability leave certified by their clinician before the parental leave begins. The disability period is paid through short-term disability rather than as parental leave, and it does not reduce the 16 weeks.

Parental leave for both parents where both work at Mosaic Robotics is 16 weeks each. The company does not pool or reduce the entitlement.

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations for eligibility confirmation
- Review leave timing within 12 months of birth or placement
- Coordinate leave blocks with manager and People Operations

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees, covering the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above the cap.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

Where the standard cap cannot be met—a remote field site with one hotel or a sold-out market—the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason; no pre-approval is needed.

Next steps:
- Book lodging through MosaicOne Travel
- Note reason if cap cannot be met

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. The request is raised in MosaicOne alongside the manager approval and names the destination, the exact dates, the workspace address and a short description of the work the employee will perform while abroad.

A trip that exceeds 30 consecutive days also requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

Work performed outside the home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

Employees must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside their home country and must be in good standing with no active performance improvement plan and no open conduct case.

Always-on VPN is required whenever a company device connects to a network that Mosaic Robotics does not control, and screens showing Confidential or Restricted material are not visible to other people. Devices are never left unattended in a public place, never checked into hold luggage, and never left visible in a parked vehicle.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review 21 days before departure
- Obtain director and manager approvals
- Notify IT Security 5 business days ahead

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports up to USD 2,500 are approved by the direct manager. Your USD 3,000 report exceeds that threshold and requires director approval with a finance business partner review.

Next steps:
- Book flights 14+ days ahead via MosaicOne Travel
- Submit expense report with itemised receipts for USD 25+ items
- Route to director and finance business partner for approval

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date.

The full required training set for every employee includes security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption, all completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one, and the new hire has 30 days from the end of the 90-day waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

Standard equipment including laptop, adapter, headset, monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock is shipped to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date and remains company property for as long as it is in service.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one, and the 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Next steps:
- Complete security training by day 14
- Finish all required training by day 30
- Make benefits elections within 30 days of day 90

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time the employee chooses.

An early laptop refresh requires direct manager approval.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment. IT sends a prepaid, tracked shipping label to remote employees before their final day, and onsite employees hand equipment to their local IT desk.

Next steps:
- Contact your manager to approve the refresh
- Coordinate timing with IT through MosaicOne
- Return equipment within 5 business days of separation

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days, naming the handler, explaining the process, and setting expectations.

Formal investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, both reporter and respondent are told in writing why and when to expect the outcome.

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours. Response means a named human contacting the person who raised the case, acknowledging what was raised, naming who owns it and describing what happens next.

Target resolution time for Severity 1 cases is as fast as the facts allow. Where a case will run past its target, the person who raised it is told in writing why and when to expect the next update.

Next steps:
- Contact Employee Relations for harassment/discrimination reports
- Refer to MosaicOne for ethics line details
- Review HR Escalation & Case Handling Policy for updates

Escalation: People Operations — people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations with your employee ID
- Request your office assignment and onsite requirement
- Confirm your manager in MosaicOne

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month, posted to the employee's MosaicOne balance on the first calendar day of each month.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the employee's direct manager. Requests of more than 15 consecutive business days or requests overlapping a declared blackout period additionally require director approval.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your PTO balance as of 2026-09-01 is 13.5 days remaining. The notice requirement depends on the length of your request: 5 business days for requests up to 5 consecutive business days, or 15 business days for requests of 6 or more consecutive business days.

Next steps:
- Determine the length of your planned PTO request.
- Submit your request in MosaicOne with the required advance notice.
- Contact your manager if you need a notice waiver.

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your PTO balance as of 2026-09-01 is 13.5 days, which covers the 3 days you are requesting.

Every PTO request requires written approval from your direct manager in MosaicOne.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the direct manager.

Recommendation — not company policy: Submit your request in MosaicOne immediately so your manager can approve it in writing before your absence begins.

Next steps:

- Obtain manager approval in writing
- Confirm approval before 15 September

A stay of 30 consecutive days or fewer in an approved country requires manager approval under the Remote & Hybrid Work Policy and nothing further from Tax & Legal.

Ireland is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

International remote work of more than 30 days requires approval from the employee's director and from Tax & Legal. Shorter stays are a direct-manager decision.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your 20-day stay (1–20 October 2026) does not require Tax & Legal review. You need written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure, raised in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates and workspace address.

Recommendation — not company policy: Notify IT Security of Ireland as your destination at least 5 business days before departure so conditional-access rules can be adjusted. Confirm your travel laptop is company-managed, full-disk-encrypted and configured for always-on VPN.

Next steps:
- Raise manager approval request in MosaicOne by 10 September 2026.
- Notify IT Security by 25 September 2026.
- Confirm device readiness with IT Security before departure.

You meet the tenure requirement: employees must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside their home country.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your stay of 3 November to 14 December is 42 consecutive calendar days, which exceeds the 30-day threshold and requires director approval and a Tax & Legal review before travel begins.

No employee may work outside their home country for more than 90 days in a rolling 12-month period; your 42-day stay counts against this limit.

You must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN and must notify IT Security of the destination at least 5 business days before departure.

You may not sign contracts or negotiate customer agreements on behalf of Mosaic Robotics while abroad.

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days requires approval from your director and from Tax & Legal; shorter stays are a direct-manager decision.

Recommendation — not company policy: Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates (3 November–14 December 2026) and workspace address at least 21 calendar days before departure.

Recommendation — not company policy: File a Tax & Legal review request at least 21 calendar days before departure; the review will determine whether shadow payroll, social security coverage, or permanent-establishment mitigation is needed.

Recommendation — not company policy: Confirm with IT Security that your travel laptop is company-managed, encrypted and on always-on VPN before you depart.

Next steps:
- Raise request in MosaicOne with exact dates and workspace address.
- File Tax & Legal review at least 21 days before departure.
- Confirm device setup with IT Security.
